title: ECMR: Evidence-Aware Deliberation Control for Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.17869v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) systems typically commit to a deliberation protocol before inference. A fixed protocol cannot allocate computation differently to resolved and unresolved instances, and it may mistake repeated support for independent confirmation. We study this failure as semantic false consensus: a confident group answer supported by narrow, duplicated, or correlated rationales. We introduce ECMR, an evidence-aware controller over frozen role-conditioned LLMs. At each step, ECMR summarizes answer concentration, support diversity and independence, contradictions, role behavior, verification history, and remaining budget, then selects whether to propose, challenge, verify, arbitrate, diversify, correct a role, or stop. translated_title: ECMR：面向多智能体大语言模型推理的证据感知审议控制
translated_abstract: 多智能体大语言模型系统通常在推理之前就预先固定一种审议协议。固定的协议无法对已解决和未解决的实例分配不同的计算量，并且可能将重复的支持误认为是独立的确认。我们将这种失败现象研究为“语义虚假共识”：即由狭窄、重复或相关的推理依据所支持的高置信度群体答案。我们提出了ECMR，一个作用于冻结的角色条件化大语言模型之上的证据感知控制器。在每一步，ECMR会总结答案集中度、支持的多样性与独立性、矛盾情况、角色行为、验证历史和剩余预算，然后选择是提出、质疑、验证、仲裁、多样化、纠正某个角色，还是停止。我们将这一决策形式化为有限时域的预算化控制问题，并推导出了充分条件，在这些条件下，状态条件化、风险触发的验证和角色纠正能够提升成本调整后的效用。
tldr: 提出ECMR证据感知控制器，通过动态选择提出、质疑、验证、仲裁、多样化、纠正或停止等行动，防止多智能体大语言模型系统中的“语义虚假共识”问题，并将其形式化为有限时域预算化控制以优化成本调整后的效用。
en_tdlr: ECMR is an evidence-aware controller over frozen role-conditioned LLMs that dynamically selects deliberation actions (propose, challenge, verify, arbitrate, diversify, correct, or stop) at each step to prevent semantic false consensus in multi-agent LLM reasoning, formulated as a finite-horizon budgeted control problem to improve cost-adjusted utility.
